A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the O-acetylation pattern in the O-antigens of Shigella and Escherichia is not as simple as was previously assumed, but rather complex, with a non-stoichiometry that is reflected by the occurrence of several patterns of acetylation in the same molecule, as revealed by NMR analysis of the deliposaccharide of the lipopolysacchride.
